title: Job: A payout audit that stops at its page cap holds payouts instead of counting as clean
body:
**Job** opened by @jlwaugh with no deposit, so its tasks can only be volunteer work.

Problem: #116 follow-up to #107 (merged in #139).

## What's wrong

Since #139, the payout audit reads every page of the treasury's proposals from a job's floor, up to `AUDIT_PAGE_CAP` (10 pages, 1000 proposals), and reports a capped read on `/api/health` (`payout_audit_capped`). But a capped read still counts as a complete audit: `duplicatePayoutProblem` returns `null` for a duplicate past the cap. Verified on #139's branch with its own test setup (recorded proposal 41, duplicate 3000, treasury at 5000): `duplicatePayoutProblem(job)` and `pendingPayouts(job).problem` are both `null`. So the approval panel (`lib/payouts.mjs:179`), `closeIfPaid` (`:459`) and `payout.mjs approve` (`:68`) would go ahead over a duplicate the read never reached. `recordApprovals` reads the same capped list.

It can't trigger at today's volume (the testnet treasury is at proposal 54), but an incomplete audit on a money path must hold, not pass.

## What to build

- When a job's audit read stops at the page cap, `duplicatePayoutProblem` returns a problem, for example "the payout audit stopped at its page cap (1000 proposals past this job's oldest payout); payouts hold until it can read them all". That holds the panel, `closeIfPaid` and `payout.mjs approve`.
- `recordApprovals` records nothing for a job whose audit is capped.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A test with the stubbed treasury from `test/payouts.test.mjs` (recorded proposal 41, duplicate 3000, `lastId` 5000): `duplicatePayoutProblem` reports the cap, `pendingPayouts(...).problem` carries it, and `closeIfPaid` doesn't close the job.
- [ ] A read within the cap behaves as today (the existing tests pass).
- [ ] `npm run check` and `npm test` pass. Money path: needs a code owner's review.
